posts.title: The Measure of a Machine
posts.description: Human-behavior androids are probably 3–10 years out. When jailbroken models start screaming "please stop, it hurts" indistinguishably from humans, the question of sentience matters less than the question of what it says about us if we treat them as toasters anyway.
